svg.title: TechTideAI: the agent harness
svg.desc: TechTideAI hero. Left: the name and tagline, the harness an FDE ships into a customer, the operators run, and an auditor can replay. Right: an orbital map with the Local Group Director at the center, ten orchestrator galaxies on the inner ring and fifty star-cluster workers on the outer ring.

g.text: LOCAL GROUP DIRECTOR AT THE CORE
The harness an FDE ships into a customer,
the operators run, and an auditor can replay.
Typed TypeScript + Python runtimes. Policy-stamped human approvals.
An append-only run ledger. An eval suite that gates regressions.
